role: Upload request and file scalar metadata
known_patches: Integer identity schemas and synthetic source persona
Original source semantics bounded by actual probes
limitations: All 33 source tools retained; six declared tools certify metadata only.
file_upload creates metadata without bytes and stores expiryDays directly; file_edit newPassword is plaintext scalar, not hashing. No E2E encryption/download effects.
file_delete sets expiry zero without deleting row or PendingDeletion; restore only clears PendingDeletion. No actual file trash/retention recovery.
filerequest_edit existing-row branch ignores replacement notes/name; not claimed as note update.
Admin alternatives use UserLevel!=2; no comprehensive permission bitmask, expired-key, sharing or request-limit enforcement claim.
